intro: 12 preguntas rápidas para saber por dónde empiezas. Si aciertas las dos preguntas de un tema, ese tema queda superado y se abren los siguientes.

questions.prompt: She ___ to the gym three times a week.
I ___ to Japan, but I'd love to go.
questions.explain: Experiencia de vida sin momento concreto: have never been.
'Last night' es un tiempo terminado: pasado simple.
Actividad larga que explica cómo estás: have been cleaning.

questions.prompt: We ___ each other since we were children.
I ___ a shower when you called.

questions.explain: Pregunta sobre un momento terminado: did you go.

questions.prompt: When I got to the airport, my plane ___.
questions.explain: Se fue antes de que llegaras: had already left.

questions.prompt: I ___ him before the party last week.
questions.explain: Experiencia anterior a un momento pasado: had never met.

questions.prompt: She was tired because she ___ all night.
questions.explain: Causa de un estado pasado: had been driving.

questions.prompt: How long ___ there before you moved?
questions.explain: Duración hasta un momento pasado: had you been living.
